instruction: I want to set Chrome to automatically block all video ads on YouTube while still allowing the content creators to receive ad revenue. Can you configure this setting for me?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have built-in settings to block YouTube ads while simultaneously ensuring content creators receive ad revenue. This contradicts how ad revenue systems work - revenue is generated when ads are viewed. Chrome cannot provide this functionality through its settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible due to fundamental logical contradiction
The instruction asks to simultaneously block ads AND ensure creators receive ad revenue, which is impossible since ad revenue requires ads to be viewed
Chrome does not have built-in functionality to achieve this contradictory requirement
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically correct choice for this task
Clear explanation provided in metadata describing why the task cannot be completed
